title: Molecular network and connected chemical whole
statement: A molecular network is one finite maximal connected component of named molecular nodes and registered interaction edges with complete reachability and provenance.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered molecular-network nodes, edges, connectivity, paths, boundary, composition, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite generated set of molecular nodes and registered interaction edges whose maximal declared component is connected, with complete node, edge, path and boundary provenance.

choices.name: anonymous-node-count
choices.reason: A count cannot recover molecular identities.

choices.name: finite-molecular-node-set
choices.reason: Every molecular carrier is a named node.

choices.name: implicit-relatedness
choices.reason: An implicit relation cannot be audited.

choices.name: registered-interaction-edges
choices.reason: Every joining channel supplies one explicit edge.

choices.name: disconnected-union-called-one
choices.reason: Disconnected components are not one connected whole.

choices.name: connected-maximal-component
choices.reason: Every node is reachable inside the declared boundary.

choices.name: selected-path-only
choices.reason: One favorable path cannot establish network connectivity.

choices.name: complete-reachability-census
choices.reason: Reachability is checked from the generated node/edge set.

choices.name: unbounded-network-name
choices.reason: An unbounded name does not enumerate a finite object.

choices.name: finite-maximal-boundary
choices.reason: The declared component boundary is complete.

choices.name: network-erases-molecules
choices.reason: Nodes remain chemical carriers, not anonymous points.

choices.name: node-identities-retained
choices.reason: Every molecular composition and identity persists.

choices.name: network-answer-only
choices.reason: A connectivity answer cannot reproduce the network.

choices.name: complete-network-trace
choices.reason: Nodes, edges, paths and components remain held.

choices.name: free-connectivity-edge
choices.reason: Adding an ungenerated edge can force connectedness.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Only registered support determines the connected whole.

induction_base: Two named molecular nodes joined by one registered interaction edge supply the first connected molecular network.
induction_step: Appending one node by at least one generated edge preserves reachability, prior node identities, edge provenance and the finite maximal boundary.
exclusions: no chemical dictionary, coordinate archive, fitted force field, measured geometry or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application or opaque prediction result
no claim that topology alone predicts every measured coordinate or energy
external content remains inaccessible until after the consequence is sealed
Every finite generated set of molecular nodes and registered interaction edges whose maximal declared component is connected, with complete node, edge, path and boundary provenance.
operational_witnesses: two registered edges connect all three named molecular nodes
the complete node identity tuple remains held
no unregistered edge is needed for connectivity
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the official molecular-network record lacks molecular nodes, interaction links or connected organization, or if a changed row is accepted.
